description: Research Assistant Nina Shah completes her archiving shift and departs through the main lobby security gate.
Dr. Adrian Vale drafts an urgent email to Director Marlow regarding unauthorized system parameter modifications.
Sofia Bennett executes a CCTV video suppression script targeting Cameras 3 and 4 from Systems Engineering Hub B3.
Automated security alert flags unauthorized Project ORION databank access using a temporary admin token.
Dr. Vale discovers Sofia attempting to clear access logs in the Archive Reading Room; Sofia incapacitates him.
Security officer Marcus Reed and medical personnel locate Dr. Adrian Vale unconscious in the Archive Reading Room.
